title: Best 3D Model Generation Tools for Organic Designs
author: Haziq12345
selftext:
I am looking for the best 3D image generation tool for creating organic 3D models. The specific model I want to generate is a detailed 3D organic figure. I have already tried the free version of Meshy AI, but the results were not satisfactory as the face often comes out distorted. I was considering purchasing a subscription, but from what I have read on the internet, even the paid version may have similar issues.

Before committing to any subscription, I would like to know if there are reliable 3D model generation tools that can produce high-quality results. If there are free or paid options that can create models similar to what I need, please let me know.

comments.author: Overall-Cry9838
comments.body:
Honestly for organic/human designs I would not rely on pure text-to-3D yet. Faces, hands, clothing folds and symmetry are still the hardest things for most generators.

You’ll usually get much better results by using clean front/side/back reference images like the ones you posted, then doing multi-image-to-3D instead of pure prompting.

I also tested Meshy a lot and was not super happy with the face consistency/topology tbh. Tripo and Hunyuan usually gave me better results for organic shapes.

For this kind of workflow, 3daistudio is prob the best platform imo because it combines multiple models like Tripo, Meshy, Hunyuan etc in one place, plus image editing/generation beforehand. Being able to fix the references first actually improves the final mesh alot.

Still, for high quality hero characters you’ll probably want some Blender cleanup afterwards no matter which generator you use.

replies.author: Haziq12345
replies.body:
Thank You for letting me know about [3D AI Studio](https://www.3daistudio.com/) and sharing the output. Right now, I have purchase Tripo AI one month license. To bad, I have spend almost all the credit. The result is quite good through. What I do is:  
1) Generate the front, left and back view of the model in Bing AI.  
2) Then remove the background and make it PNG with Affinity by Canva.  
3) Then upload the image on Tripo AI multi-image-to-3D feature and it provide the model good enough.

comments.author: Certain_Friendship16
comments.body:
you could try hitem 3d / hi3d 2.1.

from my tests, it works really well for organic shapes and characters. the output usually has a clean mesh, good uv unwrap, and the pbr texture set is pretty solid, up to 4k.

i’d still check the model in blender before using it, but compared to some other image-to-3d tools, the new 2.1 version feels much cleaner for this kind of organic design.
